sections.name: Build decision-ready spreadsheet models
sections.outcome: Given operational data and a decision need, design or revise a spreadsheet model whose inputs, calculations, checks, and summaries are organized, correct, and traceable.
includes: structuring tables and model regions for reliable calculation
deriving values with references, formulas, lookups, conditions, and aggregations
checking calculations and presenting compact spreadsheet summaries or scenarios
excludes: open-ended statistical research or formal experiment analysis
building database applications or general-purpose software
designing a visual report when no spreadsheet model is involved

sample_tasks.instruction: Create a quarterly program-budget workbook from the supplied transactions. Separate assumptions from calculated results, compute actual-versus-budget amounts by category, flag categories over budget, and add a compact summary that a director can audit back to the source rows.

Revise a volunteer-hours workbook so coordinators can enter shifts once, calculate each volunteer's total and remaining commitment automatically, and see warnings for duplicate shifts or totals that do not reconcile.

sections.name: Structure data for spreadsheet models
sections.outcome: Arrange source data, assumptions, and output regions into consistent spreadsheet tables whose grain, ranges, categories, and units support reliable downstream calculations and traceable references.
includes: choosing a calculation-ready row grain, columns, keys, and table boundaries
normalizing dates, categories, units, and missing-value conventions needed by formulas and summaries
separating source data, user assumptions, calculation regions, and outputs
excludes: writing the substantive formulas that derive business results
designing record intake, filing, version, retention, or retrieval workflows even when an index uses a spreadsheet
performing statistical inference

sample_tasks.instruction: Restructure twelve monthly sales sheets into a model-ready workbook for later margin and variance calculations. Establish one transaction grain, standardize product, date, quantity, and currency fields, separate exchange-rate assumptions, and document ambiguous source rows without writing the business formulas.

Reorganize a capacity-planning workbook whose demand inputs, staffing assumptions, and partial outputs are interleaved. Create expandable source and assumption tables, align weekly periods and units, and define traceable calculation and summary regions for the formulas that will be added next.

sections.name: Compute and check spreadsheet results
sections.outcome: Translate business rules into maintainable spreadsheet calculations, then test references, edge cases, and reconciliations so changes to inputs produce trustworthy results.
includes: relative, absolute, cross-table, conditional, date, lookup, and aggregate calculations
scenario and what-if calculations driven by explicit assumptions
error handling, reasonableness checks, subtotals, and reconciliation controls
excludes: reorganizing fundamentally malformed source tables
statistical modeling that requires specialized analytical methods
manual arithmetic whose results do not update with the workbook

sample_tasks.instruction: Add formulas to a staffing-cost model to select each employee's pay rate from a role table, calculate regular and overtime cost, and flag missing roles. Include control totals that reconcile employee detail to the departmental summary.

Repair a loan-comparison sheet in which copied formulas use the wrong rate cells and blank fees produce errors. Make the calculations robust, show total cost for three scenarios, and add checks that expose incomplete assumptions.

sections.name: Capture and maintain usable office records
sections.outcome: Create and maintain records that collect the required facts consistently, preserve status and provenance, and remain easy for authorized people to retrieve and update.
includes: designing structured intake and update workflows
validating required fields and controlled values
classifying, naming, filing, versioning, and retrieving records
excludes: structuring spreadsheet tables and regions for downstream calculation
drafting narrative documents whose primary purpose is communication
implementing enterprise databases or access-control infrastructure

sample_tasks.instruction: Design an intake and filing workflow for community-partner agreements. Capture the parties, effective dates, renewal status, owner, approvals, and supporting files, and explain how staff should update and retrieve a record without creating duplicates.

Clean up a shared collection of equipment inspection records and prevent the same problems in future submissions. Define a consistent naming and folder scheme, distinguish current from superseded inspections, produce an index for authorized staff, and revise the inspection cover form to require the metadata the cleanup found missing.

sections.name: Design reliable forms and intake flows
sections.outcome: Turn an information need into a concise form or intake sequence that elicits complete, consistently encoded, and reviewable responses from the intended users.
includes: selecting necessary fields and response controls
writing clear labels, instructions, and conditional questions
specifying required-field, range, date, uniqueness, and consistency validation
excludes: conducting research survey methodology or psychometric instrument design
structuring existing data for spreadsheet calculations or deciding long-term filing and retention policies
writing narrative reports from collected responses

sample_tasks.instruction: Create a facilities-incident intake form for employees. Collect only the information needed to route and investigate an incident, use conditional questions for injury or equipment damage, and specify validation that prevents unusable dates, locations, and contact details.

Revise a volunteer registration form that currently asks duplicate questions and allows free-text availability. Produce a shorter field sequence with consistent time-slot choices, emergency-contact checks, consent, and a final review step.

sections.name: Organize and retrieve controlled records
sections.outcome: Apply consistent classification, naming, status, version, and index information so records can be found, distinguished, updated, and retired without losing provenance.
includes: folder, filename, label, and metadata conventions
indexes, cross-references, ownership, and lifecycle status
duplicate resolution, version control, retention, and archival disposition
excludes: collecting new information through user-facing forms
reshaping tabular data to support formulas, scenarios, or analytical summaries
configuring storage systems, permissions services, or backup infrastructure

sample_tasks.instruction: Given a mixed folder of signed contracts, drafts, amendments, and scans, propose and apply a filing plan that preserves the contract relationship, identifies the authoritative version, and lets staff retrieve active agreements by partner and renewal date.

Create a records index for a training program whose attendance sheets and certificates use inconsistent participant names. Reconcile likely duplicates, retain evidence of uncertainty, and mark which records are complete, pending, or superseded.

sections.name: Produce polished workplace documents
sections.outcome: Draft, revise, structure, and format workplace documents so their content is accurate, audience-appropriate, navigable, and ready for distribution.
includes: creating and reorganizing purpose-driven prose
revising for clarity, consistency, tone, and completeness
using headings, lists, tables, styles, references, and page layout to support reading
excludes: slide-based presentation production
record classification and retention
creative writing whose primary goal is artistic expression

sample_tasks.instruction: Turn the supplied meeting notes and policy decisions into a staff procedure. Resolve repeated points, organize the steps and exceptions, add a revision summary, and format the result for quick use during daily operations.

Revise a five-page grant narrative for a mixed technical and community audience. Preserve the approved facts, strengthen the problem-to-impact argument, standardize headings and terminology, and prepare a clean final document with a concise contents aid.

sections.name: Draft and revise purpose-driven documents
sections.outcome: Transform requirements, notes, and source material into coherent document content with the right structure, detail, tone, and calls to action for its audience.
includes: outlining and drafting memos, procedures, proposals, reports, and letters
synthesizing supplied facts without inventing unsupported claims
reorganizing and editing for clarity, concision, consistency, and audience fit
excludes: page-layout polish that does not change the document's content
short conversational correspondence and inbox triage
designing a sequence of presentation slides

sample_tasks.instruction: Draft a two-page decision memo from the supplied project notes. State the decision, compare the three options using only the provided evidence, identify risks and unresolved questions, and recommend next steps for an executive reader.

Rewrite a confusing onboarding procedure so a new employee can complete it without oral guidance. Put actions in dependency order, define unfamiliar terms, separate required steps from optional tips, and surface the two escalation conditions.

sections.name: Format and finalize readable documents
sections.outcome: Apply consistent styles, layout, navigation, and final-quality checks so a document remains readable, accessible, and stable across pages and revisions.
includes: heading hierarchies, paragraph and list styles, tables, captions, and cross-references
page breaks, margins, headers, footers, numbering, and contents aids
visual consistency, accessibility checks, and final proofreading
excludes: substantive argument development or fact selection
slide layout and live-presentation support
folder naming or records-retention decisions

sample_tasks.instruction: Format the supplied employee handbook so heading levels, lists, callout boxes, page numbering, and the table of contents behave consistently. Fix stranded headings and inaccessible tables without changing the approved wording.

Prepare a print-ready version of a committee report assembled from several contributors. Standardize typography and captions, keep wide tables readable, add consistent headers and section starts, and complete a final visual and accessibility check.

sections.name: Develop audience-ready presentations
sections.outcome: Turn a communication goal and supporting material into a coherent presentation whose narrative, slides, and delivery support help an audience understand and act.
includes: planning an audience-centered sequence and selecting evidence
building legible slides with purposeful visuals and restrained text
creating speaker support, handoffs, accessibility, and final consistency
excludes: long-form document drafting
standalone data analysis whose presentation is incidental
video editing or interactive application development

sample_tasks.instruction: Develop a ten-minute board presentation from the supplied budget tables and program update. Lead to a specific funding decision, choose only the evidence needed for that decision, create a consistent slide sequence, and add speaker notes for the transitions and ask.

Rework a crowded training deck for first-time supervisors. Establish a clear learning arc, replace dense paragraphs with usable examples and visuals, add an opening objective and closing practice prompt, and make the slides accessible for projection.

sections.name: Plan persuasive presentation narratives
sections.outcome: Define the audience, decision or learning goal, evidence, and slide-by-slide progression before production so each part advances a clear presentation story.
includes: audience and purpose analysis
message hierarchy, evidence selection, and sequencing
storyboards, section arcs, transitions, and calls to action
excludes: applying final slide layouts, typography, or graphics
writing a complete prose report
inventing evidence not present in the source material

sample_tasks.instruction: Create a slide-by-slide outline for persuading a city committee to approve a pilot recycling program. Use the supplied costs, resident feedback, and operational risks; identify the purpose of each slide and the final decision request.

Plan a 20-minute orientation presentation for new volunteers. Sequence the mission, safety rules, example shift, and escalation process so the audience first understands why the work matters and then can act correctly.

sections.name: Build and refine effective slides
sections.outcome: Convert an established presentation plan into consistent, legible slides and delivery support that emphasize key information without distracting or overloading the audience.
includes: slide layouts, typography, color, spacing, images, diagrams, and data displays
speaker notes, timing cues, handoffs, and rehearsal-oriented refinements
consistency, source attribution, contrast, reading order, and accessibility checks
excludes: choosing the core argument when no narrative plan exists
performing the underlying spreadsheet analysis
producing motion graphics or edited video

sample_tasks.instruction: Build slides from the approved fundraising-pitch outline and asset folder. Use a consistent visual system, turn the impact figures into readable displays, keep citations attached to claims, and add concise notes that fit an eight-minute delivery.

Polish a nearly complete quarterly-review deck whose charts, fonts, and spacing are inconsistent. Repair visual hierarchy and accessibility, simplify overloaded slides without removing required facts, and add cues for two presenter handoffs.

sections.name: Coordinate correspondence and time commitments
sections.outcome: Maintain clear workplace communication and feasible schedules by extracting intent, preserving commitments, resolving conflicts, and issuing concise updates as information changes.
includes: drafting and managing actionable correspondence
creating and revising appointments across dates, participants, locations, resources, and time zones
tracking requests, decisions, invitations, responses, and prior schedule state across updates
excludes: full project planning with task dependencies and resource forecasts
long-form document or presentation production
customer-support decisions that require domain-specific policy judgment

sample_tasks.instruction: Review the supplied email thread about a vendor demonstration, identify the commitments and unanswered question, draft the next reply, and update the proposed meeting time so it respects every participant's stated availability.

Coordinate a rescheduled staff workshop after the facilitator becomes unavailable. Preserve the attendee and shared-room constraints across the two candidate dates, update the invitation without losing response state, and draft concise notices that distinguish the replacement from the canceled event.

sections.name: Compose and manage actionable correspondence
sections.outcome: Read communication context and produce concise messages that preserve relevant facts, match the relationship and tone, and make decisions, requests, ownership, and next steps explicit.
includes: drafting, replying, forwarding, and summarizing workplace messages
extracting requests, commitments, deadlines, owners, and unresolved questions from threads
prioritizing, routing, and following up on correspondence
excludes: allocating events into a conflict-free schedule
writing long-form reports, policies, or proposals
inventing approvals, commitments, or facts absent from the communication history

sample_tasks.instruction: Read the supplied procurement email thread and draft a reply that confirms the accepted quantity and delivery window, asks only for the missing tax document, assigns the internal approval step, and uses an appropriately firm but cooperative tone.

Triage twelve incoming messages for a program director. Group related threads, identify which require a reply today, summarize each requested action with owner and deadline, and draft the two highest-priority responses.

sections.name: Maintain calendars under evolving constraints
sections.outcome: Create, revise, cancel, and restore calendar state across successive requests while preserving event identity, temporal constraints, participant and resource state, and an accurate history of exceptions.
includes: allocating and revising single or recurring events across days while resolving exact starts, time windows, durations, availability, working hours, and non-overlap
handling dates, time zones, shared locations or resources, recurrence exceptions, reminders, and cancellation state
maintaining invitation details, participant responses, prior constraints, and recoverable schedule snapshots across updates
excludes: project plans whose primary challenge is dependency or resource optimization
drafting the substantive content of meetings or events
discarding prior calendar state or constraints merely because a later request causes a conflict

sample_tasks.instruction: Schedule a six-week training series for participants in Los Angeles and New York using the supplied availability and room calendars. Keep each occurrence at 10:00 Los Angeles time, avoid shared-room conflicts, create an exception for a holiday week, and issue invitations that show the correct local times and recurrence dates.

Starting from the supplied three-day calendar history, restore the snapshot after the second update, cancel one event, and move another after an attendee declines. Preserve event identities, durations, invitees, response state, room booking, and reminder settings, then report the complete resulting calendar and cancellation history.
